definition: [ אחר ] plural with אַחֲרֵי , preposition after (Cappadocian and Egyptian Aramaic אחר afterwards ( Lzb Eph.i. 361 S-C pap C 8 ), probably Nabataean אחר after ( Lzb 212 SAC 16 ); Egyptian Aramaic אחריכם ( S-C Pap. c 8 +); ᵑ7 (sometimes) אֲחוֺרֵי ; Biblical Hebrew אַחַר ); — אַחֲרֵי דְנָה after this Dan 2:29 ; Dan 2:45 with suffix אַחֲרֵיהֹן Dan 7:24 . Usu. Aramaic synonym בָּאתַר , q. v.
